content.headline: Exam night. Cake o'clock.
content.body: Fresh slices delivered to your hostel gate in 20 minutes, till 2am. Student price: ₹99.
content.seen: 0-2s: a tired student stares at a textbook at 1am. Text: EXAM NIGHT? 2-5s: phone buzzes, a cake box arrives at the hostel gate. Voice: fresh slices, twenty minutes, till 2am.
content.visual: Warm late-night hostel room, desk lamp glow, chocolate cake slice in a kraft box
